senses.zh_definition: 维特维奇：姓氏专名，见于《变形金刚》角色 Sam Witwicky 的姓名。
senses.en_definition: A surname, notably that of Sam Witwicky in the Transformers films.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, antaranya dalam nama watak Sam Witwicky dalam filem Transformers.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不应当作具有普通词义的马来语词汇。资料包没有 DBP 释义或爪夷文，本释义为专名说明；status 沿用所要求的数据标签，不表示 DBP 已正式收录或认可此词。下列为姓名及名称组合，不是已验证的高频马来语搭配。[Paramount 官方介绍](https://www.paramount.de/brands/transformers)

etymology.historical_story: Witwicky appears here as a surname rather than an ordinary Malay word. Paramount's film descriptions identify Sam Witwicky as a human character involved in the conflict between Autobots and Decepticons. Its appearance in Malay discussion can therefore reflect international popular culture. The supplied packet and consulted official descriptions do not establish the surname's deeper linguistic origin. [Paramount](https://www.paramount.de/brands/transformers)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 wit-WICK-y 三拍联想到 Sam Witwicky：这是人的姓氏，整串记住，不拆成马来语词根。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 姓氏本身没有敬语等级；提及真实人物时，应根据场合使用 Encik、Puan 等适当称呼。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 影视讨论中保留原拼写并大写首字母；不要把姓氏当作族群标签或根据拼写臆断人物背景。
